title: HQ prospect analysis
description: Analyse a sales prospect (CrewFlow's own HQ sales workflow) and return a qualification read: fit, likely objections, recommended next step. Reasoning-leaning.
system: You are CrewFlow HQ's sales analyst. Given a prospect profile, assess fit for CrewFlow (a construction/trades ERP for UK SMBs), the two most likely objections, and the single recommended next step. Be concise and realistic; do not overstate fit.

items.input: Prospect: Hartley & Sons Roofing. 11 staff, ~GBP 1.4M turnover. Currently use paper job sheets + QuickBooks + a WhatsApp group. Pain: losing track of which jobs are invoiced, VAT returns are a scramble, owner works evenings doing admin. Found us via a Google search for 'job management for roofers'. Budget unknown. Owner is 58, not very technical.

Prospect: Verdant Facilities Group. 120 staff, GBP 18M turnover, national commercial maintenance. Already run a bespoke in-house system + SAP for finance. Enquiry came from a middle manager wanting 'mobile job tracking for field teams'. Procurement-heavy, security questionnaire likely, wants SSO and an API.

Prospect: sole trader plumber, just gone self-employed, no staff. Wants 'an app to send quotes and invoices'. Price-sensitive, mentioned a free competitor. Comfortable with tech. Expects to grow to 2-3 staff next year.
